about_the_game:
Luscious 'shrooms await the clever slug. Set out with your pals to munch them all. Don't be careless with your moves, or you'll dry up!

Slugtrip is a 2D puzzle game about slug buds on a search for mushrooms. Movement is limited, but by working together the slugs will overcome any obstacle.

Features

  • Get yourself to some tasty 'shrooms using limited movement

  • Put that slug brain to work solving increasingly difficult spatial puzzles

  • Expand your mind by mastering the abilities of 3 unique slugs

  • Solve over 50 puzzles across 3 funky zones

  • Use your slime wisely!
